description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BarCode' for various barcode types within the PDFsharp library, including methods for creating barcodes from different parameters, properties for barcode attributes, and an abstract render method.

classes.name: BarCode
classes.description: Abstract base class for all barcode types, providing common properties, factory methods, and an abstract render method.

methods.name: FromType
methods.description: Factory methods to create barcode instances based on code type and parameters.

methods.name: InitRendering
methods.description: Initializes rendering parameters, throws exceptions if necessary properties are not set.
